Our products

Ready-made platforms, live in production

Each one solves a concrete business problem — and is already working for real customers.

🏖️

Rent.wf

Instant booking sites for villas, hotels, car rentals and yachts.

No aggregator commissions (Booking/Airbnb), a built-in AI assistant, Telegram alerts for your team — and pages that load even on weak Wi-Fi.
🚕

Taxi & P2P Marketplace Engine

A ready core for launching local taxi and guide services — like taxi.rent.wf.

Counter-offers (drivers set their own price), AI chat with tourists in their language, and no middlemen.
💬

FodyChat

A smart AI support widget for any website.

~3 KB loads instantly, answers strictly from your data (FAQ/API), and hands off to a human on Telegram. Perpetual self-host (BYOK) available.
📻
